hero.headline: Turn rough ideas into sign-off-ready SRS.
hero.subline: FlintFlow finds logic gaps, catches conflicts between UCs and NFRs before handoff to dev, and updates the document itself when the client changes requirements.

how.title: Three steps. None of them lets the spec break on its own.
how.description: Scope creep doesn't come from one big request — it comes from twenty email lines nobody checked against the spec.

scan.title: Scan existing docs for conflicts
scan.body: Drop in the .docx you already use. FlintFlow extracts every UC, NFR and business rule and shows where they clash.

template.title: Normalize to your template
template.body: The FPT template or your client's mandatory one — content lands in the right section and column, with the original formatting intact.

change.title: Change requirements without breaking the spec
change.body: Client added one line in an email? FlintFlow maps every affected spot and drafts a Change Request — nothing is written until you approve. The returned file keeps Track Changes.
